description.face: Preserve his bone structure, nose shape, eye shape and spacing, eyebrow shape and lip shape. An oval face of medium length with a high forehead; thick, dark, fairly straight eyebrows; dark brown eyes with slightly heavy upper lids; a long straight nose with a rounded tip; medium-full lips with a fuller lower lip; medium ears that stand slightly out from his head. His cheeks are moderately full, with soft tissue over the cheekbones and no hollow beneath them; under the beard his jaw is fairly square and his chin rounded; his neck is of medium thickness. His face is exactly as full or as lean as in the references, never thinner and never fuller, and at its true size in proportion to his head and body.
description.hair: His own hair exactly as in the face references: dense, tight black curls about 6 to 8 cm long on top, standing up with volume and falling a little onto his forehead; the sides above and in front of his ears tapered short and close to the scalp, so his ears and temples show; the curls continue longer at the back toward the nape.
description.beard: His beard and moustache exactly as in the face references: a full, dense, short dark beard along the whole jaw and chin, a little lighter high on the cheeks, a full dark moustache joining the beard at the corners of the mouth, and a small patch under the lower lip.
description.skin: Warm medium-brown South Asian skin tone matching the references, never lightened; real skin texture with visible pores.
description.build: A slim-to-average build with moderate shoulders: arms of moderate size with light muscle tone, a flat chest, a flat stomach with slight natural softness below the navel, a narrow waist and slim hips. His body is exactly as lean or as full as in image {BODY}: never more muscular, never heavier, never thinner.
